snippet.title: NAME OF THE WILL | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
NAME OF THE WILL is a hand-drawn daylight horror narrative adventure that gamifies peer pressure and explores collective trauma.

Set in a euphoric cult, you live as member 3279, participate in morally challenging rituals or face your neighbors' judgment. Step out of line, and the conduct system strikes back. You only have seven strikes to reveal your fate with multiple endings, all depends on how the system tallies up your actions.

Wishlist and play Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098190/NAME_OF_THE_WILL_Demo/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
